effect.create_pr: Pushes {{branch}} and opens a draft pull request into {{base}} on GitHub.
effect.publish: Marks the draft pull request {{pr}} ready for review on GitHub.
effect.reopen: Reopens the closed pull request {{pr}} on GitHub.
effect.merge_local: Merges the delivered work into {{base}} in your own repository. Your uncommitted changes are saved and restored.
effect.discard: Throws the delivered work for {{title}} away and releases its worktrees.
effect.local_discard_branch: Deletes the branch where your local changes were restored; the saved stash is kept.
effect.acknowledge_no_changes: Records that the run changed nothing.
effect.checkout: Checks {{branch}} out in your repository so you can try it.
effect.local_bring_back: Brings your restored local changes back onto {{base}}.
effect.refresh_on_base: Merges the updated {{base}} into the delivery, resolves conflicts with an agent and verifies again.
effect.recover_and_retry: Recovers the interrupted delivery of {{title}} and retries it.
effect.request_changes: Starts a revision run of {{title}} with your note.
effect.ci_fix: Starts a run that watches the CI of {{pr}} and fixes failures.
error.not_loaded: Project {{project}} is still loading. Try again in a moment.
error.not_allowed: {{decision}} is not possible now (the delivery is {{status}}). Possible now: {{offers}}.
error.note_required: request_changes needs a note: what should change.
error.path_required: file_diff needs path: a file from the changes list.
error.stale_version: The delivery changed since you read it. Review the current state.
error.stale_decision: Someone else decided this delivery meanwhile. Review the current state.
warning.packet_unavailable: The review packet is not available for this delivery.
choice.request_changes: A revision run applies your note (AI work).
choice.checkout: Switches your repository to the delivery branch.
choice.refresh_on_base: Brings in the new base and re-verifies (AI work).
choice.local_restore: Puts your stashed local changes back.
choice.local_bring_back: Applies the restored changes onto your branch.
choice.local_discard_branch: Deletes the restore branch; cannot be undone.
choice.approve: Accepts it the repository's way; cannot be undone.
